Bruttobeitrag.derivation: Synthetic example. The two release states apply the instalment surcharge before and after rounding; the difference is at most 0.1 percent of the premium, in either direction.

Kosten 2. Ordnung ohne Provisionen.derivation: Synthetic example. The right run rounds the collection cost of each instalment up to a quarter; it can come out higher by at most 0.25 per period and never lower.

Provisionen.derivation: Synthetic example. Commissions are settled in whole cents; the two runs differ only beyond the cent.

Netto-Cashflow.derivation: Synthetic example. Follows from the bound on the expenses: the net cash flow can come out lower by at most 0.25 per period and never higher.
